New Poco smartphones with large batteries and fast charging launched in India

Poco has launched its X8 series, including the Poco X8 and Poco X8 Power, in India. Both smartphones feature large batteries, with capacities of 9,000mAh and 10,000mAh respectively. The phones also support fast charging up to 100W. The Poco X8 Power is equipped with Qualcomm Snapdragon chipsets. One of the newly launched phones boasts a 144Hz display and an LED panel on its back. Another device, the Redmi 17 5G, was also launched, featuring a 7,900mAh battery, a Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 processor, and a 120Hz display.
